# Charter — T9 TOGAF ADM capability (retrospective, 2026-11-24)

- **Project:** T9 'TOGAF ADM capability', SPEC_V2 slice T9 (docs/SPEC_V2.md §12), track v2, ADM phase G, capability plateau, project `01a1d039-0d35-7bd1-945d-cea12c5dfd6d`, tranche 4. The row is `status: closed`, version 15, created 2026-11-12T14:46:02Z and updated 2026-11-24T17:04:34Z, with `meta.measured_status: built`, `meta.plan_status: draft`, `meta.viability: rework`, `meta.reopen_reason: the retrospective MSP/TOGAF/SAFe rework of tranche 4 (#526)`, `meta.reopened_at: 2026-11-24T16:57:39Z` and `meta.close_reason: the retrospective rework of T9`. The rework is carried under the standing retrospective delegation `01a1ff1f-e4ba-72dc-9c1a-13049933cf14`, which the row names as `meta.reopen_decision_ref`, and under the tranche-4 row `01a1e9e0-f4c0-727d-9afb-bb5b1e9783ce`, authorised at 2026-11-24T17:04:34Z by the review `01a20e84-325b-7fef-8f40-50b5e53550e9`.
- **Mandate:** install the TOGAF ADM capability in the conveyor — the Preliminary phase (architecture principles, the tailored ADM profile, the artefact standard and repository, the Architecture Board, governance, and the maturity and skills assessments), the architecture project type, phases A–H with typed artefacts and contracts, and delivery-project compliance and waivers — so that the gate recorded in the project meta holds: an architecture project passes Preliminary and A–F with each phase's mandatory artefacts approved and its contract live; a phase missing a mandatory artefact is refused; a delivery project without a live contract is refused at design; a compliance review records one level and a waiver names its owner and review date; an H review produces exactly one change or kata.
- **Scope:** the capability described by the SPEC_V2 §12 T9 row and by the architecture row of the capability table, which places the ADM surface at `/design/adm` and expects `adm.spec.ts`; the Preliminary artefacts (the principles catalogue, the tailored ADM profile and the artefact standard), the typed artefact repository, the phase contract lifecycle, the compliance review and waiver path, and the board, governance, maturity and skills record. This retrospective authors the seven approved A–D artefacts (stakeholder map, driver/goal/objective catalog, requirements catalog, solution concept, business capability map, data entity/data component catalog and technology standards catalog), the charter, the Statement of Architecture Work, one delivery contract, one WBS deliverable and the Phase-G compliance review, plus the project-brief and evidence pages. Out of scope: re-running the capability's runtime acceptance, superseding the existing compliance reviews, and re-closing the project.
- **Expected outputs:** the row's `meta.expected_outputs` — project-brief, inception-analysis, architecture-design, architecture-principles, adm-profile, artifact-standard, architecture-artifact, statement-of-architecture-work, compliance-review, waiver, maturity-assessment and skills-assessment — with the closure outputs evidence and closure-review. At the snapshot the record already publishes the architecture principles (`01a1f2dc-db53-7729-b0f1-686bcf81a1e4`), the tailored ADM profile (`01a1f2dd-0583-73fe-a8b5-7d1166116f4a`), the artefact standard (`01a1f2dd-1e74-77e9-8b11-1ab87a0db7fa`), the principles catalogue artefact (`01a1f2dd-3623-701c-b0ba-169d83d7907a`), the Statement of Architecture Work (`01a1f2dd-5c13-73b9-845e-3f1673585e1e`), the compliance review (`01a1f360-3420-73f4-8f42-b636a32c29c1`), the waiver `Architecture waiver — the register at 2026-11-19` (`01a1f2e0-d72c-776e-b137-a48ad1560663`), the maturity assessment (`01a1f2dd-74a7-739d-96e9-edc665a7b847`) and the skills assessment (`01a1f2dd-99d8-74fa-9f71-b02b976b4521`), plus the retrospective project brief (`01a20280-9490-7278-88dc-af487c379f55`), the evidence page (`01a1f35f-1032-72bf-a2ee-4ee1a9375550`) and the closure review (`01a20e7d-f29e-779c-a30e-9b7c5117efbf`). This pack adds authored project-brief and evidence prose; it does not duplicate the published pages.
- **What this retrospective does NOT attest:** it does not attest contemporaneous authorship or intent — the prose in this pack was written at the 2026-11-24 rework from the record, not when the capability was built. It does not re-close the project: this pack carries no closure and no closure review, and the closure record remains `01a20e7d-f29e-779c-a30e-9b7c5117efbf`. It does not re-run the capability's acceptance and does not supersede the three compliant reviews recorded against the superseded Statement of Architecture Work `01a1f2c2-0e1a-787f-9011-46b424d1ec71`, the live delivery contract `01a20280-25ea-759d-8f96-51980017b97e` and the live Statement of Architecture Work `01a2023e-4e59-75ad-b2ab-fd7d014511d2`. It does not attest a tranche-4 review of T9: the tranche row's reviews list is empty and its `review_at` is null, so no tranche-level decision on this project is in the record. Finally, it does not reconcile `meta.plan_status: draft` with `meta.measured_status: built`; that difference stays open and is carried in the evidence gap.

# Project brief — T9 TOGAF ADM capability (retrospective, 2026-11-24)

## Outcome

T9 makes architecture a governed capability of the conveyor: typed artefacts selected by phase and plateau, a live contract per phase, compliance reviews that record one level, waivers that name their owner and reassessment date, the Architecture Board and governance, and dated maturity and skills baselines. The outcome is true when the gate in the project meta holds — an architecture project passes Preliminary and A–F with each phase's mandatory artefacts approved and its contract live, a missing mandatory artefact is refused, a delivery project without a live contract is refused at design, and a Phase H review produces exactly one change or kata. The record claims the capability built (`meta.measured_status: built`); this retrospective republishes the authored lifecycle record and does not re-close the project.

## Boundary

Out of scope: re-running the runtime acceptance of the `/design/adm` surface, superseding any of the three recorded compliance reviews, and re-closing T9. The project must not fork the artefact standard into a second repository, invent a parallel status source, or turn the superseded Statement of Architecture Work 01a1f2c2-0e1a-787f-9011-46b424d1ec71 into a live contract again; the record's live/superseded states are the boundary.

## Reuse sources

- `docs/SPEC_V2.md` §12, the T9 row: the Preliminary phase set, the architecture project type, phases A–H, delivery-project compliance and waivers, and the gate text echoed in the project meta.
- The architecture row of the SPEC_V2 capability table: the ADM surface at `/design/adm`, verified by `adm.spec.ts`.
- `seed/output-standard.json`: the publication categories and the required sections for architecture-artifact, project-brief, evidence and statement-of-architecture-work.
- The Preliminary publications: architecture principles 01a1f2dc-db53-7729-b0f1-686bcf81a1e4, tailored ADM profile 01a1f2dd-0583-73fe-a8b5-7d1166116f4a, artefact standard 01a1f2dd-1e74-77e9-8b11-1ab87a0db7fa and the principles catalogue artefact 01a1f2dd-3623-701c-b0ba-169d83d7907a.
- The governance record: the SoAW pages 01a1f2dd-5c13-73b9-845e-3f1673585e1e and 01a2023e-4e59-75ad-b2ab-fd7d014511d2, the compliance review 01a1f360-3420-73f4-8f42-b636a32c29c1, the waiver 01a1f2e0-d72c-776e-b137-a48ad1560663, the maturity assessment 01a1f2dd-74a7-739d-96e9-edc665a7b847 and the skills assessment 01a1f2dd-99d8-74fa-9f71-b02b976b4521.
- The tranche-4 row 01a1e9e0-f4c0-727d-9afb-bb5b1e9783ce and its authorising review 01a20e84-325b-7fef-8f40-50b5e53550e9.

## Inception units

The inception base is the record itself, not a separate inception document: the project row holds seven approved artefacts, three contracts, three compliant reviews, one scope baseline and twenty-four published outputs, with `meta.measured_status: built`, `meta.plan_status: draft`, `meta.viability: rework` and `meta.tranche: 4`. The plan path `docs/SPEC_V2.md#12` resolves to a draft fragment rather than a standalone plan file, so the retrospective reads the record and the SPEC_V2 row together and records the difference instead of inventing plan sections.

## Dependencies

- blocked-by: T1, T3 and P0, the three keys named in `meta.depends_on`.
- sequencing: SPEC_V2 §12 states that T9 and T10 follow T1 and T3 and may run in parallel once T1 and T3 exist.
- acceptance-blocked-by: the tranche-4 exit criteria, which require every project in tranche 4 — S05, S07, S09, T10, T14, T16, T4 and T9 — to meet its acceptance with published evidence before the review records continue, pause or stop.
- blocks: the delivery projects that need a live contract and a compliance review before design and delivery, because T9 is where that obligation is defined.

## Acceptance

The acceptance is the gate in the project meta, read against the record: seven A–D artefacts approved (01a2027e-b3fc-7af8-a4d2-53e0ba2cca67, 01a2027e-e784-7a23-9098-ca96a7610047, 01a2027f-1a9a-78d0-bddb-1f7d1898d3f8, 01a2027f-4e4b-72dc-88de-d3ae876995c3, 01a2027f-835a-7682-922b-a5ed89a1c39e, 01a2027f-b71a-753f-adec-3d7c8185de80, 01a2027f-e9b2-7af9-9758-acc4947a9122); the Statement of Architecture Work 01a2023e-4e59-75ad-b2ab-fd7d014511d2 and the delivery contract 01a20280-25ea-759d-8f96-51980017b97e live; the scope baseline 01a20280-71de-7b06-9086-ae0158bfd36f taken 2026-11-22T09:05:00Z; and one recorded level per review. `python3 scripts/rework-content-check.py --project T9 --content docs/evidence/rework/tranche-4/rework-content-T9.json --snapshot <snapshot> --wsjf 10,13,10,8 --closes false` is the local acceptance of this pack. Runtime acceptance of `/design/adm` is not claimed.

## Capabilities

The capabilities T9 declares are the typed artefact repository, the phase-gated ADM lifecycle, the contract lifecycle, compliance review and waiver, the Architecture Board and governance, the maturity assessment, the skills assessment, the architecture project type and the retrospective record assembly. Maturity at the snapshot: the artefacts and contracts are approved and live, the three reviews are compliant, the maturity and skills assessments are published, the board and governance are declared in the T9 row but have no minutes in the facts, and no runtime run of the phase gates is recorded.

## Plan

The plan fragment reports `meta.plan_status: draft` and does not exist as a standalone plan file in the facts; the project row is `status: closed` at version 15 and the rework is carried under delegation 01a1ff1f-e4ba-72dc-9c1a-13049933cf14 and the tranche-4 authorisation 01a1e9e0-f4c0-727d-9afb-bb5b1e9783ce. This retrospective publishes the project brief, the evidence, the seven artefacts, the SoAW, the contract, the WBS and the Phase-G review, and deliberately carries no closure.
